full_judgment: 3. The trial court, on examination an consideration of the evidence adduced by both parties, decreed the suit by the judgment and order, dated 18.07.1980. The defendant filed Title Appeal No. 102 of 1984 in the court of the learned District Judge, Munshigoj against that judgment and decree of the trial court. The appellate court allowed that appeal and set aside the judgment and decree of the trial court. The plaintiff then preferred the above mentioned Civil Revision No. 287 of 1988 before the High Court Division and obtained rule. A single Bench of the High Court Division ultimately made that rule absolute, set aside the judgment and decree of the appellate court below and restored those of the trial court by the impugned Judgment and order.
